scenes.title: The New York Position
scenes.summary: At home, Andréa discusses with her lawyer and Colette how agency UBA withdrew her New York job offer upon learning she was pregnant, while they admire their baby ultrasound.

scenes.title: The Year-End Review
scenes.summary: At the agency, the assistants and agents worry about the upcoming year-end financial review before Andréa feels a sudden contraction, prompting Gabriel to fetch water.

scenes.title: A Glass of Water
scenes.summary: Gabriel brings a glass of water to Andréa as her contraction passes, urging her to take care of her health and rest despite the pressure of the year-end review.

scenes.title: An Indiscreet Question
scenes.summary: Still in awe that Andréa is pregnant, Gabriel asks awkward questions on behalf of a friend about how she conceived, but Andréa fiercely guards her privacy.

scenes.title: The Canet Deal
scenes.summary: Mathias boasts to Gabriel about closing a major contract for Guillaume Canet, but Gabriel counters with his lucrative deal for Jean Dujardin.

scenes.title: The Damaged Contract
scenes.summary: Gabriel and Camille discover that Jean Dujardin signed under a strange alias on moldy paper just as producer Maxime arrives.

scenes.title: The Deserter's Story
scenes.summary: Andréa pitches the intense plot of the First World War movie Le Déserteur to reassure the skeptical producer.

scenes.title: Like in The Revenant
scenes.summary: Andréa shows producer Maxime extreme footage of Jean Dujardin acting wild in the forest to justify his delay.

scenes.title: The New Movie Poster
scenes.summary: Sofia arrives at ASK excited to show Gabriel the stunning new promotional poster for her upcoming film.

scenes.title: The First Contraction
scenes.summary: At ASK, Sofia celebrates her new movie poster with Gabriel, while heavily pregnant Andréa suddenly feels her first contraction and defends her right to work.

scenes.title: Meeting with the Boss
scenes.summary: In his office, Hicham delicately questions Andréa about her pregnancy and maternity leave, while Andréa firmly asserts her independence before leaving for client Jean Dujardin.

scenes.title: The Wild Man
scenes.summary: In the garden of his country estate, Andréa finds client Jean Dujardin living wild, refusing modern hygiene, and observing circling birds of prey.

scenes.title: The Deserter Character
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel meet Jean Dujardin, who refuses to start his new banker film because he is still completely immersed in his 1870 deserter character.

scenes.title: Appointing a Managing Director
scenes.summary: Mathias vents to his wife Catherine during a yoga session about Hicham's wild expansion plans, proposing that ASK needs a proper Managing Director.

scenes.title: The Agency Meeting
scenes.summary: At the ASK conference table, Andréa and the agents discuss Jean Dujardin's method acting crisis, comparing his extreme immersion to Daniel Day-Lewis.

scenes.title: The End of The Deserter
scenes.summary: After celebrating the end of shooting with champagne, Jean Dujardin video-calls director Solveig Akerfeld to desperately pitch a sequel to The Deserter.

scenes.title: A Quinoa Salad
scenes.summary: Tard le soir dans leur appartement, Annick s'inquiète pour Camille qui s'épuise au travail, se nourrit d'une salade de quinoa et dort dix minutes sur le sol des toilettes.

scenes.title: Samuel's Advice
scenes.summary: Mathias arrive chez Camille et rassure Annick sur le potentiel de Camille comme agente, avant de transmettre à sa fille une précieuse règle de Samuel Kerr.

scenes.title: Hicham's Gift
scenes.summary: Colette et Andréa découvrent le luxueux berceau offert par Hicham, ce qui ranime les tensions dans leur couple autour de la grossesse et de la place d'Hicham.

scenes.title: A Late-Night Explanation
scenes.summary: Colette confronte Andréa sur ce qui s'est réellement passé avec Hicham à Cannes, et Andréa tente d'expliquer l'impulsion confuse et brutale de cette nuit-là.

scenes.title: A Promising Young Talent
scenes.summary: Camille welcomes young actor Brian Vallès to ASK for an exploratory meeting. Mathias walks in and mentions director Jacques Audiard, sparking Brian's excitement.

scenes.title: Noémie's Confidences
scenes.summary: At ASK after hours, Noémie confides in Hervé and Camille about her complicated feelings for her married neighbour Philippe.

scenes.title: Andréa's Comfort
scenes.summary: Andréa visits Jean Dujardin after his breakdown on set. Despite the lost commission, Andréa comforts Jean and admits she should have protected him better.

scenes.title: Seven Months
scenes.summary: In her ASK office, Andrea declines a drink, prompting Jean Dujardin to notice her rounded belly. Realizing Andrea is seven months pregnant, Jean warmly congratulates her and reflects on the timeline of his own grueling shoot for Le Déserteur.

scenes.title: Not the Coat
scenes.summary: As Jean Dujardin prepares to leave Andrea's office, Andrea offers him his coat, but Jean declines it to feel the cold air and shake off his wild character. Andrea encourages him to rest before the agency's general meeting.

scenes.title: A Film Selection
scenes.summary: Jean Dujardin se prépare à rentrer à Paris avec Andréa. Avant de partir, il emprunte un film culte et lui demande de lui préparer une sélection personnalisée.

scenes.title: Annual Review and Probation
scenes.summary: Hicham Janowski dresse le bilan annuel de l'agence ASK. Après avoir salué les succès d'Andréa, Mathias et Arlette, il annonce le renvoi de Gabriel pour faute grave, avant de lui accorder une seconde chance sous la tutelle d'Andréa.
